title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Strawberry Snoow Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Snoow from Elfliq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is everything you want from a sweet and creamy treat on a hot summer’s day – or any day of the year. Deliciously rich and smooth, the tangy sweetness of a fresh strawberry coulis layered over luscious dairy ice cream is a flavour that never fails to put a smile on your face, and this fantastic Elfliq e-liquid makes for an easy and uplifting all-day vape. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
